verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs mention isolated container/ephemeral execution environments for production workloads (vercel-docs-12, vercel-docs-3), which implies fast, elastic compute typical of edge/serverless platforms, and a community comment confirms the platform does scale dramatically under load (e.g. DDoS traffic driving huge bills) (vercel-comm-12). However, there is no explicit documentation of sub-second boot times or concrete scale benchmarks (e.g. 'tens of thousands' of instances), so the story is only thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit cold-start/boot latency numbers, documented concurrency/scale limits or benchmarks, independent load-test verification.
